title: Nuclear Glow Up! — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Radioactivity and nuclear chemistry for CHEM 3A (Chapter 14), built on Dr. Dan's Lecture 30, the Chapter 14 learning objectives and the Week 17 MyOpenMath homework. Seven modes: Decay Lab (tap alpha, beta, positron, electron capture or gamma and watch a nucleus of protons and neutrons change, with the balanced equation, neutron-to-proton ratio and band of stability), Balance It! (complete nuclear equations box by box, then name the decay type; bombardment reactions), Shield Lab (alpha, beta, gamma and neutron sources, paper/aluminum/lead/concrete shields, a Geiger counter with background, the inverse-square rule and ionizing power), Half-Life Lab (watch a sample halve, graph it, and solve half-life, radiocarbon and activity problems), Fission & Fusion (chain reaction with critical mass and control rods; D-T fusion that needs high temperature), Radiation & You (isotopes, units, health effects, radon, medical isotopes such as Tc-99m, I-131 and F-18 PET) and a 10-question Skill Check with a study plan. Lab questions require a step in the lab before checking. Every question explains the right answer and each wrong choice; hints link to matched ItsDrDan videos.
